parties.respondent: The State of Tamilnadu Rep. By Inspector of Police

summary: Sentence modification under IPC 307; appellant convicted of attempted murder against mother-in-law with billhook following marital discord; High Court reduced life sentence to 12 years RI; legal error: maximum imprisonment if avoiding life term is 10 years not exceeding; precedent cited (Jagat Bahadur, Amit Rana) establishing appellate court cannot impose higher sentence than trial court's maximum; sentence modified to 7 years RI considering relationship, injuries; convictions under 498A, 324, 506(II) partially confirmed but 506(II) acquittal upheld; concurrent sentences maintained; appeal partly allowed.
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed; sentence under Section 307 IPC modified to 7 years RI; other convictions confirmed with concurrent sentences as directed by High Court.
